summary: The Greyhound Protection Act of 2025 amends the Animal Welfare Act to prohibit commercial greyhound racing, live lure training, and open field coursing nationwide if the greyhounds or bait animals are moved in interstate or foreign commerce. It also bans gambling, simulcasting, and the transport or possession of greyhounds for these activities, establishing criminal penalties for violations.

affected_groups.effect: Will be prohibited from participating in commercial greyhound racing, live lure training, or open field coursing, and from transporting or possessing greyhounds for these purposes, under threat of fines and imprisonment.
Will be prohibited from conducting races with betting, placing wagers, or facilitating simulcast betting on greyhound races.

key_provisions: Prohibits knowingly engaging in commercial greyhound racing, live lure training, or open field coursing involving interstate commerce.
Bans conducting commercial greyhound racing or meetings where betting or wagering on greyhounds occurs.
Prohibits live lure training or open field coursing using any bait that is not an inanimate object, and adds hares to the Animal Welfare Act definition of animals.
Bans engaging in or facilitating simulcast betting or wagering on greyhound races across state or foreign lines.
Prohibits selling, buying, possessing, training, transporting, delivering, or receiving any greyhound for commercial racing, live lure training, or open field coursing.
Establishes criminal penalties of fines, imprisonment for not more than 7 years, or both, for each violation.
Sets the effective date for these prohibitions as conduct occurring on or after October 1, 2027.

summary_detail.plain_summary: The Greyhound Protection Act of 2025 amends the Animal Welfare Act to prohibit commercial greyhound racing, live lure training, and open field coursing nationwide if the greyhounds or bait animals are moved in interstate or foreign commerce. It also bans gambling, simulcasting, and the transport or possession of greyhounds for these activities, establishing criminal penalties for violations.
summary_detail.significance: The bill federalizes restrictions on greyhound racing and related blood sports by amending the Animal Welfare Act. Its potential significance is substantial for the remaining commercial dog racing industry, as it imposes federal prison terms and fines for activities tied to interstate commerce, taking effect on October 1, 2027.
